train_vlm_model: run the train function to train a vision language model using a config with dataset paths and model settings
collate_vlm_examples: use collate_fn to tokenize prompts, labels, and images into processor tokens for a VLM batch
load_vlm_dataset: load training and validation datasets from disk or Hugging Face Hub using the train function
configure_vlm_processor: initialize an AutoProcessor for a pretrained VLM model with trust remote code enabled
create_vlm_trainer: build a Hugging Face Trainer with a VLM model, datasets, and a custom data collator
